title: SuperAdmin login endpoint + GetFleetSettings read-DTO completion
notes: FIX 1 — POST /api/v1/auth/admin/login (AllowAnonymous). Request: { "email": string, "password": string }. Response (same shape as staff login, StaffLoginResponse): { "accessToken": string, "refreshToken": string, "user": { "id": guid, "email": string, "displayName": string, "role": "SuperAdmin" } }. 401 on unknown email / not-a-SuperAdmin / wrong password (uniform, with dummy BCrypt.Verify on absent-user paths to preserve StaffLogin timing-uniformity). 400 on malformed/missing email or missing password (Validation.EmailRequired/EmailInvalid/PasswordRequired via ValidationFailureExceptionHandler). Resolve predicate: Users.IgnoreQueryFilters() where Email==req.Email && Role==SuperAdmin && FleetId==null && IsActive (matches SuperAdminBootstrapper, which stores email as-is and sets IsActive=true). JwtIssuer fleetless-mint: no new overload needed — jwtIssuer.IssueAccessToken(user, fleetSlug: null); since user.FleetId==null the token carries role=SuperAdmin and NEITHER fleet_id NOR fleet_slug (identical to the customer VerifyCode path). Refresh token issued normally (RefreshToken has no FleetId). AdminLogin is a slice of the existing Auth feature — reuses AuthFeatureConfiguration and StaffLogin's StaffLoginResponse + StaffUserDto. Tests seed the valid/e2e SuperAdmin via the real SuperAdminBootstrapper.CreateAsync (true CLI path) and assert the token by DECODING it (never replaying — FakeTimeProvider clock trap); the login->/admin/fleets->200 chain uses the existing E2ETaxiApiFactory LifetimeValidator workaround. FIX 2 — GetFleetSettingsResponse gained PrimaryColorHex (from Fleet, nullable), WelcomeText (from FleetSettings, nullable), SmsMonthlyCapCzk (from FleetSettings, default 500 when no row). These are exactly the PUT-minus-GET delta; GET now fully round-trips the editable set accepted by PUT /fleet/settings (name, phone, primaryColorHex, welcomeText, offerTimeoutSeconds, smsMonthlyCapCzk, autoDispatchEnabled). No migration, no CLAUDE.md trap. OpenAPI allowlist updated (expected HashSet in SeedAndEndToEndTests) and docs/api.md regenerated by the test.
